payload.reason: The evidence indicates that actual exposed MIS 5e facies are not consistently found in synthetic well logs, suggesting a preservation bias and erosion affecting the visibility of these facies.

claims.text: Actual exposed MIS 5e facies are lacking in synthetic well logs due to preservation bias and erosion.
Preserved exposed fossil MIS 5e reef facies are observed at specific locations, but not universally in the geological record.
The lack of preserved reef facies under certain sea level scenarios limits the understanding of paleo relative sea level changes.
